Package com.sca4d.core.spring.identity

Class PrincipalSelectionCallInterceptor

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.core.spring.identity.PrincipalSelectionCallInterceptor
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.sca4d.core.api.call.CallLifecycle.Around, com.sca4d.core.api.call.CallLifecycle.Participant
public class PrincipalSelectionCallInterceptor extends Object implements com.sca4d.core.api.call.CallLifecycle.Around
在 CallLifecycle 的环绕阶段执行 CurrentPrincipal 声明的业务身份选择，并把结果写入当前 Call。
